data.text:
🚨WINTER TRAFFIC ADVISORY! 🚨

Due to the increased number of accidents on the road, the Douglas County Sheriff’s Office will now only be responding to accidents involving injuries and or hazards on the roadway(s).

If you are involved in a crash and there is only minor damage, no injuries, and no alcohol involved, please exchange information with the other party, move the vehicles off the roadway and contact the DCSO when the advisory is lifted. Thank you for your cooperation.

Please slow down, increase following distances, use your headlights to increase your visibility, and drive safely.
